text: This is Saigon. It's a street parallels to Tudo street. It was a street of flowers. To the left is the Presidential Palace and to the right is the Mekong River and a floating restaurant where I almost got blown up. The floating restaurant was called the MyChan (pronounced "My-Can") floating restaurant, it was like a barge. They had a claymore mine and when it fires, it fires 700 buckshot bullets in a curve and it's deadly. I was in front of the restaurant and a friend named Lopez invited me to the restaurant called the Peacock and when we entered the Peacock the MyChan blew up. It was like a guardian angel. Lopez was my pal throughout the cub scouts. Lopez was part of the Marines and just showed up at this moment to invite me to the Peacock. It was a miracle he showed up. The next day i took pictures of the MyChan restaurant of it blown up. The picture may be missing though.
